paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
notes: Paper (NASDUCK-SERF) constrains both ALP-neutron (gaNN) and ALP-proton (gaPP) couplings using a 3He/39K SERF comagnetometer over mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. The paper highlights as its novel contribution the FIRST reliable terrestrial bounds on ALP-PROTON coupling, hence AxionProton chosen over the AxionNeutron hint, though both are equally constrained (which is why confidence is 0.5). Exact tabulated bounds are in a GitHub repository (Ref [57]); data_points are approximate readings from Fig. 2 (gaPP plot) and text (regions 5e-6 to 2e-5 GeV^-1 and 1-9e-3 GeV^-1 partially closed). Values in GeV^-1. For neutron coupling (gaNN), limits range ~1e-7 to 1e-3 GeV^-1 over same masses. No explicit local DM density quoted in text (Standard Halo Model used).
